lines.en: Sam, I made you some soup. Enjoy.
Well, don't mind if I do, Mr. Note.
Hey, no, no, no, no, no!
Who do you think you are? You monster!
That's my stuff! That's my stuff!
Don't kill me! I'm not ready!
Hey, um, can we lower the microphone a little bit?
A little lower. A little lower.
Oh! No, no, no, no, no, no!
Uh, I said I wanted hot sauce, and there wasn't no hot sauce on my tray.
You should've put it on my tray in the first place.
You know I wanna put it right now?
You watch your mouth before I put my fist in it!
You say you're sorry to the customer.
And on your web show, you said all you gotta do is answer this brain buster.
And I was the first person to send in the correct answer to iCarly.com.
We're not saying you didn't win the car.

I know the only reason you act like this is 'cause you're insecure,
but that doesn't make it OK for you to--
I'd love to see her try it.
Is that how you call it?
Is that how you call it?
You're insane and you're squeezing my shoulders!
I'm not entering a beauty pageant!

Yes! You're insane and you're squeezing my shoulders!
- Please! - I'm not entering a beauty pageant!
- Sam's throwing a tantrum. - I know.
- We know. - What happened? Did we run out of bacon?
She's mad 'cause I refused to enter a beauty pageant.
- You know you're gonna give in. - Not this time.
All right, I'll be in the stupid pageant!
